critical_findings.title: Echo private-branch.* subscription fails on first KDS/OSS load (stale empty Bearer token)
critical_findings.symptom: First /api/broadcasting/auth POST after login carries Authorization: "Bearer " (empty token) → Laravel auth:sanctum returns HTTP 302 redirect to /login. Pusher does not treat 302 as pusher:subscription_error, so the channel stays subscribed:false forever. KDS receives KitchenReleaseRule/OrderCreated/KdsOrderRecalled broadcasts NEVER on that browser session — polling fallback (5-10s cadence) silently masks the regression.

evidence.auth_call_1: authPrefix="Bearer" (empty), status=302, response has Location header

critical_findings.root_cause_hypothesis: bootstrap.js sets auth.headers.Authorization at Echo construct time via _getEchoBearerToken() (reads localStorage.vuex). On a hard page navigation that starts from /login, Vuex is empty at the moment Echo is constructed; Echo subscribes before _refreshEchoAuth() runs. The subsequent _refreshEchoAuth update of the headers object does NOT trigger Pusher to re-attempt the failed subscription, because the 302 was never surfaced as pusher:subscription_error.
critical_findings.production_impact: Every KDS/OSS browser session that loads after login (the common case) operates in polling-only mode. Owner-perceived "live sync" is actually 5-10s lagged. Wave Polish Final Q9-S1 measured ~1s cross-surface sync — that measurement may have been on a refreshed session where Echo eventually recovered via a different path; first-load case stays broken silently.
critical_findings.suggested_heal: Either (A) detect 302 response on broadcasting/auth in bootstrap.js _bindSubscriptionErrorHandler and force re-subscription, OR (B) defer Echo instantiation until Vuex hydration has completed (e.g. after first authToken mutation), OR (C) have channel subscription retry automatically when window._refreshEchoAuth() runs and current subscribed=false.

critical_findings.title: OSS Echo subscription intentionally skipped for admin (branch_id=0)
critical_findings.symptom: PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:260 `if (branchId <= 0) return` early-returns the subscribeEcho() call for admin users. Admin opens /admin/order-status-screen → no Echo, polling only.

evidence.design_intent: Admin is cross-branch, no single private-branch.X channel suffices
evidence.risk: If admin watches OSS during peak service, latency is 5-10s polling not <500ms Echo

critical_findings.severity_rationale: Design choice (not a bug per se), but worth documenting in V1 backlog for V2 multi-branch OSS subscription strategy.

verdict_reason: Scenarios: 4 PASS / 1 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL. Critical P0 surfaced: Echo private-branch.* subscription silently fails on first KDS/OSS load due to empty-Bearer race (HTTP 302 from broadcasting/auth, not handled by pusher:subscription_error). Polling fallback masks the issue but cross-surface sync regresses from <500ms (Echo) to 5-10s (polling). See critical_findings[WSDC-P0-01].
